## Top 移动信号

- **SKHY**: Trump admin weighing new sweeping semiconductor tariffs — bearish near-term overhang on SK Hynix US-listed equity; HBM supply chain globally exposed.
- **SKHY**: NVIDIA signals memory (not demand) is the AI bottleneck; HBM4E volume production at $4B Indiana facility H2 2029 confirms capacity moat — bullish structural thesis intact.
- **RKLB (via RKLX, 2x)**: $2.36B backlog + $456M suborbital defense contracts scaling independent of Neutron — thesis-strengthening catalyst; 2x leverage amplifies upside on any bullish re-rating.
- **SPCX (via SPCH, 2x)**: Musk, Altman, Huang, Sacks all at US-hosted G20 tech summit — sentiment catalyst for AI/space narrative supporting SpaceX ecosystem; 2x amplifies beta to thematic flows.
- **CRCL**: Wolfe keeps Underperform but hikes PT $50→$65 (+30%) — Street slowly conceding upside, still no Buy rating; modest tailwind only.

## Per-ticker 简报

- **CRCL**: Wolfe maintains Underperform, PT $50→$65 — Street warming but no rating upgrade; neutral-to-mild-positive.
- **RKLB**: Whale options activity detected in industrials (RKLB included) — flow signal, watch for unusual call volume; bullish tape confirmed by SeekingAlpha strong-buy thesis ($234M Q2 rev, $2.36B backlog).
- **SPCX**: Crown Castle "2026 Reset working" piece is adjacent tower-infrastructure, low direct relevance to SpaceX; Musk/Grok "I'll cover your losses" promo is noise; G20 tech meeting is the real signal.
- **SKHY**: $4B Indiana packaging facility groundbreaking + HBM4E production timeline — multi-year capacity lock-in bullish; offset by Trump semi-tariff threat and NVIDIA margin compression narrative (71-72% Q4 GM).

## 风险 Watch

- **Semi tariffs**: Trump admin weighing new sweeping chip tariffs (Politico) — direct risk to SKHY if exports hit.
- **NVIDIA margin wall**: First AI-cycle GM compression (memory costs) — read-through to NVDA suppliers including SK Hynix; if sustained, multiple compression risk.
- **CRCL**: Persistent Underperform rating despite PT hike — analyst not yet convinced on fundamentals.
